typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Status as string,
		{Process Name} as string,
		Modified as date,
		{Process ID} as string,
		{BPM Process Link} as string,
		{Control ID} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		Status as string,
		ProcessName as string,
		Modified as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ProcessID as string,
		BPMProcessLink as string,
		ControlID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		ProcessName = {Process Name},
		Modified,
		ProcessID = {Process ID},
		BPMProcessLink = {BPM Process Link},
		ControlID = {Control ID}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
